name: Ticket Digest
description: Summarizes incoming support tickets into a short brief: issue, requester, and suggested next step.

name: Meeting Scribe
description: Turns meeting transcripts into notes with decisions, owners, and open questions.

name: Campus Translate
description: Translates family-facing emails and letters between English and Spanish, with a human review step.

name: Macro Shelf
description: Shared library of recorded macros for repetitive clicks in the student information system and the helpdesk console.

name: Sheet Dedupe
description: Script that finds and removes duplicate rows in spreadsheets, matching on email or student ID.

name: Newsletter Draft
description: Drafts the weekly family newsletter from a bullet list of announcements.

name: Helpbot Classic
description: Old chatbot that answered staff IT questions from a static FAQ. Replaced by Ticket Digest.

name: Roster Matcher
description: Matched student names across enrollment spreadsheets. Shut down after accuracy problems with similar names.

name: Lunch Menu Board
description: Publishes the weekly cafeteria menu to the staff intranet. Does not read or write other documents.

name: Parking Permit Desk
description: Tracks staff parking permits and lot assignments. No document, ticket, or communication features.
